lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Suit jacket tight, it doesn't quite fit
I'm standing here just waiting for it
String lights glowing in the warm summer air
I catch your gaze, I'm already there
[chorus]
You're sweet like sugar, sweet forever
No more counting nights, we're bound together
Saying yes to every tomorrow with you
My forever, my one, my sweet, sweet, mine at last
[verse]
Family cheering from every side
Nowhere to run and nowhere to hide
That smile, that laugh, the way you say my name
After today, it won't be the same
[chorus]
You're sweet like sugar, sweet forever
No more counting nights, we're bound together
Saying yes to every tomorrow with you
My forever, my one, my sweet, sweet, mine at last
[bridge]
Boots on the dance floor, glasses all clink
Life is a dream, it's better than I think
Hooked from the first kiss to this dance tonight
Everything's perfect, everything's right
[chorus]
You're sweet like sugar, sweet forever
No more counting nights, we're bound together
Saying yes to every tomorrow with you
My forever, my one, my sweet, sweet, mine at last
[outro]
